battle.name: 延州之戰
battle.theater: 陝西延州（今陝西省延安市）
battle.brief: 延州之戰發生於一〇四〇年，是北宋與西夏在陝西延州地域交鋒的邊境戰事，宋軍依託延州防線抵禦西夏軍進攻，也是宋夏長期邊爭的一部分。條目所列的希臘火（Greek fire）在六百七十年已正式列裝，是拜占庭帝國攻守軍用體系中的燃燒投射器材。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 本役是北宋與西夏在陝夏邊境的一場圍城、破寨與救援戰，主戰年份為康定元年，即1040年；核心地是鄜延路治所延州，約在今陝西延安一帶。宋軍以鄜延路守軍為基幹，陝西各路區則依軍令提供援軍或接應，實際進入延州戰場的部隊不能與環慶、涇原、秦鳳等處的佈防混為一談。西夏由其景宗李元昊統率主力，從北方山地與邊境據點向宋境壓進，外圍金明寨、青澗川及通向延州的道路都與戰局直接相關。本文只追蹤1040年延州戰役的部署、交戰與退兵，不把1081年五路攻宋、1082年永樂城之役或此後所有宋夏戰事籠統算入。
countriesEn: This engagement was a siege, campaign against outer stockades, and relief operation fought by the Northern Song and Great Xia, conventionally called Western Xia, on the Shaanxi–Xia frontier. The main year was Kangding 1, or 1040, and the center was Yan Prefecture, the seat of Fuyan Circuit, in the area of present-day Yan'an, Shaanxi. The Song force had the Fuyan Circuit garrison as its core, while the wider Shaanxi circuit system could provide reinforcements or support; troops stationed in Huanqing, Jingyuan, and Qinfeng must not all be treated as having fought directly below Yan Prefecture. Li Yuanhao led the Western Xia main body from the northern mountain zone and border strongholds toward Song territory. Jinming Stockade, the Qingjian valley, and the roads leading to Yan Prefecture all had direct operational significance. This account follows only deployment, combat, and withdrawal in the 1040 Yan Prefecture campaign; it does not fold in the Five-Route Campaign against Song of 1081, the Battle of Yongle of 1082, or all later Song–Xia warfare.
people: 宋仁宗趙禎是北宋方面的最高決策者，延州失守與援軍敗退的消息送抵朝廷後，陝西各路的指揮與兵員調度隨之調整；西夏景宗李元昊不只提供兵力，還在延州一線直接統率主攻。延州守軍主將李士彬負責城防與外圍作戰，史料中屬宋方赴援將領之一的劉延安參與了救援行動，種世衡則在危急之際推動青澗川的築城與北方通道的防衛，後來更以此形成新的邊防支點。夏竦代表宋廷在較高層次整頓陝西軍務，但不宜把他寫成始終站在延州城下親自指揮每一場戰鬥的人。當時沈括尚未入仕，范仲淹也不是延州的統兵者，因此二人不列為本役指揮人物。
peopleEn: Song Emperor Renzong, Zhao Zhen, was the highest decision-maker on the Northern Song side. Once reports of the danger at Yan Prefecture and the defeat of the relief force reached the court, command and troop movements within the Shaanxi circuits were adjusted. Western Xia Emperor Jingzong, Li Yuanhao, personally directed the principal offensive around Yan Prefecture rather than merely supplying troops from a distance. Li Shibin, commander of the Yan Prefecture defenses, directed the city and its outer fighting, while Liu Yan'an, identified in the records as one of the Song relief commanders, took part in the rescue operation. Zhong Shiheng promoted the construction of a fortified position in the Qingjian valley and the defense of the northern approaches during the emergency, creating what later became an important support point for the frontier. Xia Song represented the court in the higher-level reorganization of Shaanxi military affairs, but he should not be portrayed as standing before Yan Prefecture throughout the battle and personally commanding every engagement. Shen Kuo had not yet entered official service, and Fan Zhongyan was not a commander at Yan Prefecture, so neither is listed as a battlefield leader in this campaign.
kits: 本役沒有留下能逐件核對的雙方軍械清冊，因此只能採用1040年以前確已存在的裝備，不能把後來武器倒填進來。宋軍城防以弓、弩為主要遠射手段，弩手可使用踏張弩或床弩這類早於本役的既有弩型，實際消耗的是弩矢與普通箭矢；步兵配備槍、刀、盾，並可穿皮甲或札甲，近射與遮蔽時使用橹、大盾。偏厢車、拒馬槍屬宋代以前已有的野戰防護裝置，糧車及馬匹負責運輸糧秣、箭矢、飼料與軍需。西夏軍採取騎兵與步兵混合的作戰方式，騎兵使用弓箭、長槍與刀，步兵使用弩、槍、盾，並有披甲部隊；營帳、糧秣和武器同樣依靠馬匹及車隊輸送。這些都是當時的真實裝備類型，但史料不能證明每一件都曾投入延州之戰，裝備數量、消耗量與各部實際配備仍不可補寫。
kitsEn: No surviving ordnance ledger permits every item on both sides to be checked, so the equipment described here is limited to types demonstrably in use before 1040; later weapons cannot be projected backward into the battle. Song defenders relied primarily on bows and crossbows for missile fire. Crossbowmen could use foot-powered crossbows or bed crossbows, both established weapon types long before this campaign, while their ammunition consisted of crossbow bolts and ordinary arrows. Infantry carried spears, sabers, and shields, with leather or lamellar armor available for protection, and pavises or large shields could provide cover during close fighting. Side-box war wagons and anti-cavalry spear obstacles were established field and encampment protections before the Song, while baggage wagons and horses transported grain, arrows, animal fodder, and other military supplies. Western Xia combined cavalry and infantry: mounted troops used bows, long spears, and sabers; foot soldiers employed crossbows, spears, and shields; and some units were armored. Their tents, provisions, and weapons likewise depended on horses and wagon transport. These are genuine period equipment types, but the records do not show that every item was deployed at Yan Prefecture, and exact stock levels, expenditure, and unit allocations cannot be reconstructed responsibly.
tactics: 西夏軍的主要作法是先在金明寨方向打開外圍通道，再以騎兵和步兵封鎖接近延州的道路，把延州城置於重兵包圍之中。圍城本身不是全軍同時強攻，而是留下部分兵力監視城防，以主力等候宋方援軍；其戰略核心可概括為圍城打援。宋援軍若沿鄜延路南段及相鄰通道北上，便可能在狹窄的黃土丘陵、峽道與寨堡間遭逢騎兵遮斷和步兵伏擊，糧車與輕裝部隊尤其容易與主力失去銜接。延州守軍則依托城牆、牆上射位和城門控制，以弓弩壓制接近者，派出小股兵力反擊、偵察和清理外圍，盡量避免讓本已有限的援軍在城外被逐一吃掉。種世衡推動的青澗川防禦點可威脅西夏軍由北方山地返回延州地區的通道。史料足以確認圍城、外圍破寨與救援失敗的整體部署，卻不足以還原每次假退、伏擊或進攻的細節，因此不能另行編造局部戰術。
tacticsEn: The Western Xia approach was to open the approaches around Jinming Stockade, use cavalry and infantry to seal the roads leading toward Yan Prefecture, and then place the city under a heavy blockade. The siege did not involve the entire army assaulting the walls simultaneously. Part of the force maintained pressure on the defenses while the main body waited for Song reinforcements; the central method was to besiege the city and defeat relief forces. If a Song relief army advanced along the southern approaches to Fuyan Circuit or through neighboring routes, it could be cut off by cavalry and ambushed by infantry among the narrow loess hills, ravines, and stockades. Baggage trains and lightly equipped troops were particularly liable to lose contact with the main body. The Yan defenders relied on the city walls, elevated missile positions, and control of the gates. They used bows and crossbows against approaching troops, sent small detachments to reconnoiter, clear the perimeter, and conduct limited counterattacks, while trying to prevent the limited relief force from being defeated piecemeal outside the city. The fortified position in the Qingjian valley promoted by Zhong Shiheng threatened the corridor through which Western Xia forces could return from the northern mountain zone. The surviving evidence supports the overall pattern of siege, breach of the outer fighting line, and failure of the relief operation, but it does not preserve the exact arrangement of every feigned retreat, ambush, or assault.
data: 可核對的時間線從1038年開始：寶元元年十一月，李元昊稱帝並建立大夏，與北宋的關係由册封與互市轉向軍事對抗。寶元二年，即1039年，夏軍在西北邊境持續出擊，宋廷隨即停止或嚴格限制官方歲賜與互市，並懸賞捕拿元昊，衝突因而升級。寶元二年末至康定元年春，戰火集中到延州方向；康定元年，主要圍城與宋方援軍交鋒落在春季至入夏前後，金明寨等外圍節點受創，延州被圍，劉延安等率援軍趨近後在城外戰線遭到挫敗，延州守軍則在李士彬率領下繼續抵抗。種世衡在戰局仍未完全結束時推動青澗川築城，使延州北方多出一個可駐兵、屯糧和遮斷道路的支點；至康定元年內，西夏軍撤離延州地區，這場主要戰役遂告結束。《宋史·夏國傳》與《資治通鑑》均記載此役，但對進攻、援助與退兵次序的敘述並不完全一致。後世常把元昊所集兵力概括為十萬，這是史書的兵勢描述，不是經過核對的編制數；宋軍總兵力、雙方逐戰傷亡及俘虜數字同樣缺乏一致可靠資料，因此不能寫成精確傷亡。
dataEn: The verifiable chronology begins in 1038. In the eleventh month of Baoyuan 1, Li Yuanhao proclaimed himself emperor and founded Great Xia, and relations with the Northern Song moved away from investiture and trade toward military confrontation. In Baoyuan 2, or 1039, Western Xia forces continued operating along the northwestern frontier. The Song court then suspended or severely restricted the official annual grants and border trade and offered a reward for the capture of Yuanhao, causing the conflict to escalate. From late 1039 into the spring of Kangding 1, fighting concentrated in the direction of Yan Prefecture. During Kangding 1, the principal siege and the clash between Song relief forces and Xia troops occurred from spring into the period before the summer heat. Outer positions such as Jinming Stockade were badly damaged, Yan Prefecture was surrounded, and a relief army led by commanders including Liu Yan'an suffered a reverse while approaching the city. Li Shibin and the Yan defenders continued to resist. While the campaign was still unfolding, Zhong Shiheng promoted the construction of a fortified position in the Qingjian valley, giving the northern side of Yan Prefecture a new base for troops, provisions, and control of the roads. Within Kangding 1, the Western Xia force withdrew from the Yan Prefecture area, ending the main campaign. Both the History of Song, in its treatise on the State of Xia, and the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance record the war, although their sequences for the attacks, relief efforts, and withdrawal are not fully identical. Later accounts often summarize Yuanhao's assembled force as 100,000, but this is a literary description of military strength rather than a verified establishment figure. No consistent reliable totals exist for the Song army, casualties on either side, or prisoners, so no precise loss figures can responsibly be supplied.
cause: 延州之戰的直接誘因是宋夏官方關係在寶元二年的全面破裂。此前元昊要求宋朝承認其帝號，宋廷則維持既有外交框架，並在邊境衝突加劇後削奪賜予的官爵、限制互市、懸賞捕元昊；雙方都把軍事行動當作迫使對方讓步的手段，零星 raid 遂演成大軍攻宋。戰略層面上，西夏需要奪取延州，切斷宋方在鄜延路的前沿，打開通向環慶與秦鳳方向的通道，使北方山地根據地與宋境內的交通相連。宋方原有防禦則以相距較遠的前置寨堡為主，延州附近的金明寨等節點彼此支援有限；一旦外圍道路被切斷，援軍必須穿過不利於大隊展開的地形，城內守軍與城外援軍容易分離。這場戰爭因此不是單一城邑突然遭到偷襲，而是外交破裂、西夏集中兵力與宋方邊防結構脆弱三項因素同時作用。
causeEn: The immediate trigger for the Yan Prefecture campaign was the complete breakdown of official Song–Xia relations during Baoyuan 2. Yuanhao had required the Song to recognize his imperial title, while the court maintained the existing diplomatic framework. As border fighting intensified, the Song stripped away the titles and privileges previously granted, restricted trade, and placed a reward on Yuanhao's capture. Each side used military force to compel the other to give way, and isolated raids developed into a major campaign against the Song. Strategically, Western Xia needed to seize Yan Prefecture, sever Song communications in the Fuyan sector, and open an axis toward Huanqing and Qinfeng so that its northern mountain bases could be linked more securely to the Song interior. The Song frontier had relied heavily on forward stockades separated by considerable distances. Positions around Yan Prefecture, including Jinming Stockade, had limited mutual support, and once the outer roads were cut, relief troops had to pass through terrain unfavorable to large formations. The garrison inside the city and the approaching relief army could therefore be separated. The war was consequently not a sudden surprise against one isolated town. It resulted from the conjunction of the diplomatic rupture, Western Xia's ability to concentrate forces, and structural weaknesses in the Song frontier system.
impact: 就眼前戰果而言，西夏軍打擊了金明寨等宋方外圍節點，又迫使宋軍在延州城下與援軍戰線付出重大代價；宋廷必須承認原有寨堡配置無法單獨應付西夏主力。然而，攻勢最盛之時仍未能迫使延州城投降，西夏也沒有取得可長期占有的延安式據點，延州及其南面的宋方交通仍在宋軍手中。較長期的影響是宋方把青澗川建成新的軍事節點，使防禦由孤立外寨逐步轉向有縱深、有補給據點的部署，並重新強調鄜延、環慶、涇原、秦鳳之間的指揮聯繫與糧秣輸送。西夏軍未能消滅延州宋軍，卻證明封鎖道路、破外寨和擊敗援軍可以迅速扭轉邊境局勢；宋軍守住延州，也顯示城市防禦與北側新堡結合後能迫使遠來攻軍承擔更長的供應線。此次戰役沒有終止宋夏戰爭，1041年及以後的邊境攻擊仍持續進行，但延州之戰確實改變了雙方下一階段部署防禦的方式。
impactEn: In the immediate term, the Western Xia army damaged or overwhelmed Song positions around Jinming Stockade and forced the Song to incur serious losses both inside the Yan Prefecture defensive perimeter and along the approach of its relief force. The court had to acknowledge that the existing network of isolated forward stockades could not by itself contain a concentrated Western Xia army. At the height of the offensive, however, the Xia did not compel Yan Prefecture to surrender and gained no long-term occupation of the city. Yan and the Song routes south of it remained in Song hands. The more lasting effect was that the Song established the Qingjian position as a new military node. Frontier defense gradually shifted from isolated outposts toward a system with depth, garrison bases, and supply points, while the court again emphasized command coordination and grain transport among Fuyan, Huanqing, Jingyuan, and Qinfeng. The Xia failed to destroy the Song army at Yan, but demonstrated that road control, attacks on outer forts, and the defeat of relief troops could rapidly reverse a border situation. The Song retention of Yan showed that city defense combined with a fortified point to the north could impose longer supply lines on an invading army. The campaign did not end Song–Xia warfare, and border attacks continued in 1041 and afterward, but it changed how both sides organized the next phase of the conflict.
result: 戰役結束時，西夏在局部戰場上取得了可見成果：宋方外圍寨堡與援軍戰線遭到嚴重打擊，延州一度被圍；但西夏最核心的目標仍是奪取延州，這一目標沒有實現，延州城沒有落入西夏手中，守軍也未被全部消滅。雙方都不能把此役說成一場歼灭性的单方面胜利。對西夏而言，遠征軍可以完整撤出邊境，保留再攻能力，卻未取得足以改變陝西邊界的永久據點；對宋而言，雖然付出外寨、兵員與補給上的損失，仍守住了延州這一樞紐，並在戰後更重視青澗川與區域聯防。1040年的主要戰事隨西夏軍撤離延州地區而終止，之後留下的外圍失地、修築中的新城與重新編組的軍務都成為下一階段的起點。關於雙方確切傷亡，現存史料不能支持一個負責任的總數，任何過度精確的傷亡數字都不應被採信。
resultEn: When the campaign ended, Western Xia had achieved visible local results: Song outer stockades and the relief-force approach suffered severe damage, and Yan Prefecture had been under siege. Yet the central Western Xia objective remained the capture of Yan, and that objective was not achieved. The city did not fall to Western Xia, and its Song garrison was not wholly destroyed. Neither side can properly describe the result as an annihilating one-sided victory. Western Xia could withdraw its expeditionary force with enough strength to campaign again, but it gained no permanent stronghold capable of reshaping the Shaanxi frontier. Song suffered losses in outer forts, personnel, and supply, yet retained Yan Prefecture as a strategic pivot and placed still greater importance on Qingjian and regional coordination after the campaign. The principal fighting of 1040 ended when the Western Xia force withdrew from the Yan Prefecture area. The lost outer positions, newly constructed fortified points, and reorganized command system then formed the starting conditions for the next phase. Surviving sources do not support a responsible exact total for casualties on either side, and no claim of highly precise losses should be accepted.
